mount.eternalrealm.horse.desc.ja: 白いたてがみの黒い軍馬。蒼い馬衣と白金の鎧をまとう
mount.eternalrealm.horse.desc.en: A black warhorse in blue barding and white-gold armour

mount.eternalrealm.griffin.desc.ja: 鷲の頭と蒼白の大翼をもつ、鎧のグリフォン
mount.eternalrealm.griffin.desc.en: An armoured griffin with an eagle head and azure wings

mount.eternalrealm.bike.desc.ja: 白石と金で組まれ、蒼く光る車輪で走る魔導の二輪
mount.eternalrealm.bike.desc.en: An arcane two-wheeler of pale stone and gold

mount.eternalrealm.none_owned.ja: 乗り物を持っていない。王都の南門のそばにいる厩舎長から買える
mount.eternalrealm.none_owned.en: You have no mount. The stablemaster by the capital's south gate sells them

mount.eternalrealm.not_here.ja: ここでは乗り物を呼べない

mount.eternalrealm.in_combat.ja: 戦闘中は乗り物を呼べない
mount.eternalrealm.in_combat.en: You cannot call a mount in combat

mount.eternalrealm.in_boss_fight.ja: ボス戦の中では乗り物を呼べない
mount.eternalrealm.in_boss_fight.en: You cannot call a mount during a boss fight

mount.eternalrealm.in_water.ja: 水の中では乗り物を呼べない
mount.eternalrealm.in_water.en: You cannot call a mount in water

mount.eternalrealm.down.ja: 倒れている間は乗り物を呼べない
mount.eternalrealm.down.en: You cannot call a mount while you are down

mount.eternalrealm.no_room.ja: ここは狭くて乗り物を呼べない
mount.eternalrealm.no_room.en: There is no room for a mount here

mount.eternalrealm.left_boss_fight.ja: ボス戦が始まり、乗り物は退いた
mount.eternalrealm.left_boss_fight.en: A boss fight begins: your mount withdraws

mount.eternalrealm.left_here.ja: ここには乗り物を連れて入れない

mount.eternalrealm.fight_on_foot.ja: 戦うには乗り物から降りる
mount.eternalrealm.fight_on_foot.en: You get off your mount to fight

mount.eternalrealm.bought.ja: %1$sを手に入れた！ %2$sキーで呼び出せる
mount.eternalrealm.bought.en: You got the %1$s! Press %2$s to call it

mount.eternalrealm.not_enough_gold.ja: ゴールドが足りない（%s G）

mount.eternalrealm.hint.ja: WASDで進む、スペースでジャンプ、スニークで降りる
mount.eternalrealm.hint.en: WASD to ride, Space to jump, Sneak to get off

mount.eternalrealm.flight_hint.ja: スペースで上昇、スニークで下降（地上でスニークすると降りる）
mount.eternalrealm.flight_hint.en: Space climbs, Sneak descends (Sneak on the ground to get off)

mount.eternalrealm.stable.none.ja: まだ乗り物を持っていない

npc.eternalrealm.stable_master.ja: 厩舎長 ハルヴァン

mount.eternalrealm.stable_full.ja: 厩舎がいっぱい（%s頭まで）
mount.eternalrealm.stable_full.en: Your stable is full (%s mounts at most)

mount.eternalrealm.not_at_stable.ja: 王都の厩舎長のそばで行える
mount.eternalrealm.not_at_stable.en: Do this next to the stablemaster in the capital

mount.eternalrealm.rerolled.ja: 厩舎長が別の%sを4頭連れてきた
mount.eternalrealm.rerolled.en: The stablemaster brings out four other: %s

mount.eternalrealm.reveal.ja: 個体値の合計 %1$s・ランク%2$s

mount.eternalrealm.lucky.ja: 【厩舎】%1$sがランク%2$sの%3$sを手に入れた！

mount.eternalrealm.deed_made.ja: %sを作った（騎獣は厩舎を出た）

mount.eternalrealm.deed_not_tradeable.ja: 魔導二輪は証書にできない
mount.eternalrealm.deed_not_tradeable.en: An arcbike cannot be made into a deed

mount.eternalrealm.deed_already_kept.ja: この騎獣はもう厩舎にいる
mount.eternalrealm.deed_already_kept.en: This mount is already in your stable

item.eternalrealm.mount_deed.level.en: Can be taken in from Lv%s

item.eternalrealm.mount_deed.use.ja: 王都の厩舎長のところで厩舎に迎え入れる。売り買いもできる
item.eternalrealm.mount_deed.use.en: Take it into your stable at the stablemaster; it can also be traded

mount.eternalrealm.stable.kind_line.ja: Lv%1$s〜・%2$s G・全力疾走の約%3$s倍
mount.eternalrealm.stable.kind_line.en: From Lv%1$s · %2$s G · about %3$s× a sprint

mount.eternalrealm.stable.values_later.ja: 個体値は買ってからわかる
mount.eternalrealm.stable.values_later.en: You learn its values once you buy it

mount.eternalrealm.stable.at_stable.ja: 購入と証書は王都の厩舎長のそばで
mount.eternalrealm.stable.at_stable.en: Buy and use deeds next to the stablemaster in the capital

mount.eternalrealm.stable.machine.ja: 機械なので個体差はない
mount.eternalrealm.stable.machine.en: A machine: every one is the same

mount.eternalrealm.stable.deeds_note.ja: カバンの中の騎獣の証書。厩舎に迎え入れると乗れる
mount.eternalrealm.stable.deeds_note.en: Mount deeds in your bag: take one in to ride it
